newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares quieter, index creeps higher.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares quieter, index creeps higher.

text.p: Estonian stock exchange trade was quieter on Friday after the boom of recent days but the index rose further, the bourse said.
The main list volume reached 23.8 million kroons and the index gained 0.03 percent to 144.14.
Shares in Forekspank were the most traded on turnover of 7.7 million kroons and it closed at 102 kroons versus 99 kroons.
Fourth largest bank, Tallinna Pank, turned over 3.7 million kroons but it eased to 52.80 kroons from 54.15.
Market leader Hansapank closed higher at 143.50 kroons against 142 on turnover of three million kroons.
Over-the-counter market trade was a healthy 12.7 million kroons and the Rakvere meat processer turned over some four million kroons as it ended slightly lower at 8.95 kroons.
The Tallinna Kaubamaja department store pushed its price up to end at 72.75 kroons versus 69.50 and had volume of 3.5 million kroons.
